instruction: CORRECTNESS-lens R1 review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020H.3.1 (release-gate auto-issue) at branch feature/wp-scp-022-020h3-1-release-gate-auto-issue, commit 1a12f68. The slice extends release-gate.yml (just merged at PR #79 / commit 42f49db) with a new step that opens a release-gate-violation GitHub issue on push:tags failure. VERIFY: (1) permissions: now lists `contents: read` AND `issues: write`. The workflow's other steps still only need contents: read, so issues: write is purely for the new step. (2) The new step is gated correctly: `if: failure() && github.event_name == 'push'`. Dry-runs (workflow_dispatch) never trigger an issue. Verify the syntax + that `failure()` evaluates correctly when ANY prior step in the same job fails. (3) Step env: GH_TOKEN, CANDIDATE_TAG, RUN_URL, SCP_RELEASE_GATE_ASSIGNEES. SCP_RELEASE_GATE_ASSIGNEES has `:-jrnb2024` default in the bash. (4) The bash logic: (a) assignees fallback `${SCP_RELEASE_GATE_ASSIGNEES:-jrnb2024}` correctly handles unset OR empty. (b) tag fallback `${CANDIDATE_TAG:-${GITHUB_REF##refs/tags/}}` correctly handles the case where Resolve-tag step failed. (c) gh issue list --search uses `"${title}"` quoted — verify the GitHub search-API substring match works. (d) gh issue comment on existing match. (e) Python heredoc with single-quoted `'PY'` delimiter — verify shell metacharacters in CANDIDATE_TAG / RUN_URL cannot inject. (f) gh issue create with --label thrice + --assignee + --body. (5) The Python heredoc: imports os, builds template string, .replace() for __TAG__ + __RUN_URL__, prints. Verify the placeholder substitution is correct + the resulting markdown is well-formed. (6) Workflow header text update: 'will open' → 'AND opens'. Cross-check against VERSIONING.md and ADOPT-001 §12.7.7 — all three should agree. (7) STATUS.md TF-020H3rg-003 closure description: matches the actual diff. STATUS.md 020H.3 IN FLIGHT row backfilled with PR #79 + commit 42f49db. STATUS.md 020H.3.1 IN FLIGHT row added. 'Last updated' bumped. (8) DISPATCH-NOTE accuracy: every claim about file content matches HEAD. (9) policies/VERSIONING.md 'Machine enforcement (2)' subsection: '(per TF-020H3rg-003)' qualifier removed; replaced with explicit cross-reference to slice 020H.3.1. (10) ADOPT-001 §12.7.7 SCP-EREL-001 row: 'auto-opens a release-gate-violation GitHub issue assigned to @jrnb2024 per 020H.3.1 closure of TF-020H3rg-003' wording. (11) Naming/path: dispatches/020h3-1-auto-issue/ avoids collision with existing dispatches/020h3/ + 020h3-release-gate/. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON. NEVER recommend descoping.
